summary: This directory serves as the dedicated test suite for the internal directory concept processing logic. It ensures that the generation, loading, and summarization of directory-level metadata and architectural records function correctly within the system.
responsibilities: Verify the accurate generation of directory concept documentation
Validate the loading mechanisms for architectural concept definitions
Test the construction of file summary records
relationships: The directory concept generation relies on the metadata retrieved through the loading process.
File summary records provide the granular data necessary to construct higher-level directory architectural concepts.
designDecisions: Co-location of unit tests within an internal namespace to isolate validation logic from core production code
Test-driven validation of metadata processing pipelines
